title: Carasent AB (publ) – Interim report January–September 2025
content:
Carasent AB (publ) – Interim Report January–September 2025

Q3 2025 Performance:
- Net sales reached 82.2 MSEK, representing 27% growth compared to 64.5 MSEK year-over-year
- Organic growth contributed 13%, with acquisitions and divestitures accounting for 14 percentage points
- EBITDA climbed to 23.6 MSEK with a 29% margin, up from 6.3 MSEK (10% margin)
- Operating income (EBIT) improved to 7.2 MSEK versus negative 8.5 MSEK previously
- Net income totaled 14.1 MSEK compared to negative 2.0 MSEK

Year-to-Date Q3 2025 Results:
- Net sales increased to 250.3 MSEK, up 27% from 196.5 MSEK
- EBITDA reached 49.6 MSEK with a 20% margin versus 20.3 MSEK (10% margin)
- Operating income turned positive at 1.7 MSEK from negative 30.4 MSEK
- Net income improved to 5.6 MSEK from negative 18.0 MSEK
